fb5c71b954:
So you're the one who wants to call yourself a "Red"?
We can't just let anyone take that name.
2321449baf:
We intend to test whether you are worthy of it.
Well? Will you take up the challenge?
bac341f349:
...
Oh, you've got guts!
Guess we'll have to show you a thing or two!
c2229bd11c:
The Red Comet, the Crimson Lightning...
For mobile suit pilots, epithets involving
"red" carried a special meaning.
fa87a92dad:
A red machine stands out on the battlefield and draws
enemy fire. Pilots called "Red" needed the skill and
nerve to shrug that off.
3e2afb6e1e:
Because I held the Captain back,
I have tarnished the name of "Red"...
13bc7f5abe:
It's fine, Lieutenant Angelo.
It only shows how strongly
he feels about being "Red."
a7a3974dca:
...You have good eyes.
You are a pilot to the core.
Let us meet again on another battlefield.
b910fa6a28: Hey, did any Zeon remnants come through here just now?
3ff4bf37f9:
Calm down, Kai!
Not everyone who flies a red
mobile suit is Char!
b885dd7fac:
No, it was Char for sure!
I'm not letting any Zeon get away!
c1938c290e:
...Sorry for all the fuss.
Oh, and congratulations on the title of "Red."
Keep up the good work!
3d476a27ba:
Tch, I won't accept this!
Not from someone like you...
e9434957ad:
That's enough, Cagalli.
You saw it when you fought.
They're the real deal.
b4cfbd9dc9:
Oh, come on.
Just think of it as one more "Red" friend.
7bbaee6098:
...You're right.
Sorry, I went too far.
83fd4296c3:
Okay, now that you've made up,
let's head home.
Take care of yourself!
c6d1125cc8:
You beat me.
From today on, you can call yourself a "Red" too.
793c307cf0:
I must admit it.
You are worthy of being called the strongest "Red."
1c8e18a8a9:
Next time we meet, it'll be on another battlefield.
A red machine... We'll surely spot each other!
Well, take care!
